requirements_summary.summary: Participium is a web application for the Municipality of Turin enabling citizens to report urban issues (e.g., potholes, trash) via an interactive map or Telegram bot. Reports undergo a lifecycle from submission and approval by a Public Relations Officer to assignment, execution (by internal staff or external maintainers), and resolution. The system supports anonymity, two-way communication between citizens and operators, real-time notifications (email/push), and detailed public/private statistics.

requirements.text:
As an unregistered user
I want to see approved reports on an interactive map 
So that I can know about issues in my area and beyond.
expected_behaviors: I can know about issues in my area and beyond

requirements.text:
As a technical office staff member
I want to assign reports to external maintainers
So that specialized maintainers can handle and update the intervention.
constraints: It can be possible for specific reports of certain categories (e.g., Enel X for category Public Lighting) based on their content reviewed by the technical office staff member.
expected_behaviors: specialized maintainers can handle and update the intervention

requirements.text:
As an external maintainer 
I want to update the status of a report assigned to me
So that I can updated citizens about  the intervention.
expected_behaviors: I can updated citizens about  the intervention

requirements.text:
As a technical office staff member/external maintainer
I want to exchange information and comments on the report internally
So that coordination happens without exposing internal notes to citizens
expected_behaviors: coordination happens without exposing internal notes to citizens

requirements.text:
As a citizen
I want to register with my name and username 
So that I can access the Participium system and submit reports.
constraints: Registration is required before submitting reports.
expected_behaviors: I can access the Participium system and submit reports

requirements.text:
As a citizen 
I want to confirm my registration with a code
So that my account becomes valid and I can start using the system.
constraints: Once a registration is completed, the user gets an email with a confirmation code. The person can use the application only after confirming by entering the code valid for 30 minutes.
expected_behaviors: my account becomes valid and I can start using the system

requirements.text:
As a system administrator
I want to set up municipality users
constraints: These are the internal accounts of the municipality

requirements.text:
As a system administrator
I want to assign roles to municipality users
constraints: Possible roles: municipal public relations officer, municipal administrator, technical office staff member, external maintainer. You can be more specific on technical offices to run realisti scenarios following the official organizational structure of the municipality of Turin (https://trasparenza.comune.torino.it/media/2212/download)

requirements.text:
As a citizen 
I want to provide details for my report 
So that the the problem is classified correctly.
constraints: Mandatory fields: title, description,  category , photos (min 1 max 3).
expected_behaviors: the the problem is classified correctly

requirements.text:
As a municipal public relations officer
I want to review and approve or reject reports 
So that only valid reports are processed further.
constraints: Rejected reports must include an explanation. If accepted, the report is assigned to the technical office bound to the report category.
expected_behaviors: only valid reports are processed further

requirements.text:
As a citizen 
I want to see approved reports on an interactive map 
So that I can know about issues in my area and beyond.
constraints: Map should be zoomable. When zooming out, reports can be grouped into a cumulative report for a better visualization (total number should be reported on the cumulative report). When zooming in,  reports can be seen separated, with their title and reporter name (or "anonymous" if this is flagged on that report).
expected_behaviors: I can know about issues in my area and beyond

requirements.text:
As a technical office staff member
I want to see the list of reports assigned to me
So that I can get an overview of the maintenance to be done
expected_behaviors: I can get an overview of the maintenance to be done

requirements.text:
As a citizen 
I want to configure my account
So that I can better manage notifications and my virtual presence.
constraints: Citizens can  upload a personal photo, add their Telegram username and switch off/on email notifications in the configuration panel.
expected_behaviors: I can better manage notifications and my virtual presence

requirements.text:
As a system administrator
I want to modify roles to municipality users
So that the staff can be more flexible.
constraints: This story overwrites a previous answer given by PO on the Telegram chat. NB: 1) A municipality user can now have multiple roles, i.e. serving on more than one technical office. 2) Modification includes cancellation.
expected_behaviors: the staff can be more flexible

requirements.text:
As a technical office staff member 
I want to update report statuses 
So that citizens are informed of the problem resolution process.
constraints: At each status change, the citizen receives notification in the platform with the corresponding update. Municipal operators working on reports can also send messages to the citizens in the platform, to which the citizen can reply.
expected_behaviors: citizens are informed of the problem resolution process

requirements.text:
As a citizen 
I want to reply to messages from municipal operators in the platform 
So that I can communicate directly about my report.
constraints: Two-way communication is possible within the platform.
expected_behaviors: I can communicate directly about my report

requirements.text:
As a citizen/unregistered user
I want to browse a summary table of reports with filters 
So that I can easily explore and analyze existing reports.
constraints: Filters: by category, status, period of time
expected_behaviors: I can easily explore and analyze existing reports

domain_rules: Reports must be in 'Pending Approval' state until the Organization Office performs preliminary verification.
Accepted reports move to 'Assigned' state and are sent to the competent technical office based on category.
Rejected reports require a mandatory explanation from the Municipality Organization Office.
Once submitted, a report cannot be modified or deleted by the citizen.
Anonymous user's name is visible to staff but hidden in the public Turin map of reports for citizens.
Only technical office staff members can have multiple roles.
External maintainers are added by the system administrator and must have their own individual account.
Case 1 (External maintainer has access): Internal comments between staff and maintainer are report-specific and reserved (not visible to reporter/citizens).
Case 2 (External maintainer no access): Communication happens out of Participium; technical office updates status to 'Resolved' externally.
Automatic assignment of all issues of a certain category is possible only if previously set by the municipal administrator.
Public statistics include number of reports by category and trends by day/week/month.
Private statistics (admin only) include breakdowns by status, type, reporter, and combinations including top 1% and 5% reporters.
Email is a mandatory field for registration and can be used for login.
Confirmation code for registration is valid for 30 minutes.
edge_cases: When zooming out on the map, reports are grouped into a cumulative report showing the total number.
When zooming in on the map, reports are separated, displaying title and reporter name (or 'anonymous').
If a citizen disables email notifications in their configuration panel, they do not receive email copies of platform notifications.
A municipality user can have multiple roles, serving on more than one technical office.
Public Relation officer can assign a report either to a specific technical office or directly to a staff member of that office.
Notifications/messages can be set to be sent in real time or when the page is refreshed, depending on preference.
assumptions: The 'Organization Office' refers to the central administrative body responsible for initial review and rejection explanations.
Competent technical office is determined by the problem category (e.g., Public Lighting -> Enel X or specific office).
Telegram bot integration requires the user to have provided a valid Telegram username in their profile.
The 'top 1%' and 'top 5%' reporters are calculated based on volume of reports submitted.
Unregistered users can view reports but cannot submit new ones or follow reports.

authentication_notes: Initial session creation via POST /sessions is unauthenticated. All subsequent operations requiring user context depend on this session.
Citizen registration (POST /registration) is public but profile access requires authentication after registration and verification.
Admin endpoints (e.g., /admin/*) likely require elevated roles beyond basic authentication.
Public report visibility is available via GET /reports/approved without authentication.
Operations marked auth_required need an authenticated session during test setup.
dependencies: POST /sessions must precede all authenticated operations.
Email verification flow (POST /citizens/verification-code -> POST /citizens/verify-email) is required before full citizen profile management.
Admin user creation (POST /admin/createuser) must precede category assignment operations (POST/DELETE /admin/*category).
Report creation (POST /reports) is a prerequisite for all report-specific operations (status updates, assignments, comments, messages).
Chat and notification operations depend on existing reports or sessions.
POST /reports -> GET /chats/{reportId}: A report must exist before an operation can address reportId.
POST /reports -> POST /chats/{reportId}/read: A report must exist before an operation can address reportId.
POST /sessions -> GET /sessions/current: Session token from POST /sessions is required for authenticated GET /sessions/current.
POST /registration -> GET /citizens: Citizen must be registered and authenticated to access their profile.
POST /citizens/verification-code -> POST /citizens/verify-email: Verification code must be generated before email verification can occur.
POST /admin/createuser -> POST /admin/addcategory: Operator must exist before categories can be added to them.
POST /reports -> PUT /reports/{id}/status: Report must be created before its status can be updated.
POST /reports -> PUT /reports/{id}/operator: Report must exist before an operator can be assigned.
POST /reports -> GET /reports/assigned: Reports must be created and assigned before they appear in the assigned list.
POST /reports -> POST /reports/{id}/internal-comments: Report must exist before internal comments can be added.
POST /reports -> POST /reports/{id}/messages: Report must exist before chat messages can be added.
GET /chats -> GET /chats/{reportId}: Chat list must be available before specific chat details can be retrieved.

risks: Ambiguity in role-based access control: endpoints like /admin/* and /reports/assigned imply role checks but do not specify required roles.
Verification token expiry handling is implied by response code 423 but not explicitly documented in the flow.

strategy_items.requirement_summary: Unregistered user can view approved reports on an interactive map.
strategy_items.prompt: Execute a GET request to /reports/approved without providing any authentication headers or session tokens. Verify that the response returns a list of approved reports suitable for display on a map, including necessary metadata like location and status.
strategy_items.rationale: Validates the public accessibility of approved reports as per requirement PT28 for unregistered users.

strategy_items.requirement_summary: External maintainer updates the status of an assigned report.
strategy_items.prompt: Authenticate as an external maintainer. Execute a PUT request to /reports/{id}/status with a new status value (e.g., 'Resolved'). Verify that the status update is accepted and persisted correctly.
setup_needed: Authenticate as external maintainer via POST /sessions.
Create or locate the resource referenced by the path parameter.
strategy_items.cleanup_strategy: Verify no resource was created; delete it if unexpectedly present.
strategy_items.rationale: Validates the ability of external maintainers to update report statuses per PT25.

strategy_items.requirement_summary: Technical office staff member assigns a report to an external maintainer.
strategy_items.prompt: Authenticate as a technical office staff member. Execute a PUT request to /reports/{id}/mainteiner with an invalid or non-existent external maintainer ID. Verify that the system returns an appropriate error code (e.g., 404 Not Found) and does not perform the assignment.
setup_needed: Authenticate as technical office staff member via POST /sessions.
Create or locate the resource referenced by the path parameter.
strategy_items.cleanup_strategy: Verify no resource was created; delete it if unexpectedly present.
strategy_items.rationale: Ensures the system handles invalid maintainer IDs gracefully and prevents unauthorized or erroneous assignments.

strategy_items.requirement_summary: Unregistered user can view approved reports on an interactive map.
strategy_items.prompt: Execute a GET request to /reports/approved without authentication. Verify that the response includes only approved reports and excludes any pending or rejected reports, ensuring data privacy for unregistered users.
strategy_items.rationale: Tests the filtering logic to ensure only approved reports are visible to unauthenticated users.

strategy_items.requirement_summary: Citizen registers with name and username to access the system.
strategy_items.prompt: Execute a happy path registration. Provide a unique username, valid email, and password. Verify response indicates successful registration or returns a session token if immediate login is implied by the API design (though auth_required is null, check for 201/200). Ensure no duplicate username error occurs.
strategy_items.cleanup_strategy: Delete created resources or restore their previous state.
strategy_items.rationale: Core functionality for user onboarding; must succeed with valid inputs.

strategy_items.requirement_summary: Citizen confirms registration with a code to activate account.
strategy_items.prompt: Execute the verification flow. First, trigger code generation (if separate) or assume code is provided in body/header based on auth_required=true. Submit a valid 6-digit code within the 30-minute window. Verify account status updates to 'verified' and access is granted.
setup_needed: Perform POST /registration first to create an unverified user session.
strategy_items.cleanup_strategy: Delete created resources or restore their previous state.
strategy_items.rationale: Critical security step; must handle valid code submission correctly.

strategy_items.requirement_summary: Citizen replies to messages from municipal operators.
strategy_items.prompt: As a citizen, send a reply message to an existing report. Verify the message appears in the conversation thread accessible via GET /reports/{id}/messages and is attributed to the citizen.
setup_needed: Post an initial message from an operator role to establish context.
strategy_items.cleanup_strategy: Delete the created report using DELETE /reports/{id} after verifying message history is cleared or archived appropriately.
strategy_items.rationale: Ensures two-way communication flow between citizens and operators.

strategy_items.requirement_summary: Internal comments workflow: Add comment, verify visibility, then clean up.
strategy_items.prompt: Execute a stateful workflow: 1) Create a report. 2) Add an internal comment as staff. 3) Verify the comment is visible to staff via GET /reports/{id}/internal-comments. 4) Verify the comment is NOT visible to a citizen role attempting to access the same endpoint.
setup_needed: Authenticate as technical office staff member.
strategy_items.cleanup_strategy: Delete the created report using DELETE /reports/{id} to remove all associated comments and ensure no orphaned data remains.
strategy_items.rationale: Validates the complete lifecycle of internal comments, including state transitions and role-based visibility.

strategy_items.requirement_summary: System administrator assigns roles to municipality users.
strategy_items.prompt: Create a new municipality user with a specific role assigned by the system administrator. Ensure the request body includes valid user credentials and the target role ID.
setup_needed: Ensure an active authenticated session for a system administrator exists.
strategy_items.cleanup_strategy: Delete created resources or restore their previous state.
strategy_items.rationale: Validates the core functionality of role assignment during user creation as per PT03.

strategy_items.requirement_summary: Citizen provides details for their report to ensure correct classification.
strategy_items.prompt: Submit a new report with complete and valid details (title, description, category) from a citizen's perspective. Verify the response confirms successful submission and initial state 'Pending Approval'.
setup_needed: Ensure an active authenticated session for a verified citizen exists.
strategy_items.cleanup_strategy: Delete created resources or restore their previous state.
strategy_items.rationale: Tests the primary report submission flow and initial state transition defined in domain rules.
